title: Audit evidence: what it uses
lede: One arrow for each component this feature lists. The steps reuse the feature's own "how it works" text; nothing here is a new claim.

steps.title: Gateway log
steps.why: At audit close the customer needs evidence of what the gateway decided.

steps.title: AI Guard
steps.what: A request-side block by AI Guard carries compliance mappings (MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI RMF, OWASP LLM), findings, and request, span and trace ids for joining to the trace view.
steps.why: At audit close the customer needs evidence of what the gateway decided.

steps.title: Cedar AI policy denials
steps.what: A Cedar policy denial of an LLM reply is a different mechanism from the AI Guard withhold; its event carries the decision, policy ids, principal, agent key and grant shape, and no compliance mapping was shown on it.
steps.why: At audit close the customer needs evidence of what the gateway decided.
